# Workplace booking

## Requirements

- Desks must be released if unused 30 minutes after the booked time, under Facilities Policy 6.

## Stories

- As a colleague, I want to book a desk for a day so that I have somewhere to sit. Acceptance: a booking is released automatically if nobody has checked in 30 minutes after the booked time.
- As a colleague, I want to see who sits nearby so that I can find a teammate.
